cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

mechanism: A copies a composed appearance without understanding it and waits for B hurt admission before disclosing matching pain.
confusable: D112 specifically shares hurt first; D88 can seek longing or attachment.
comparison: Cancelled family dinner versus degrading workplace remark.
seedUse: Keep B specific admission unlocking A tears, but repair malformed candle-allergy wording.
